hook.say: GTA 6 just smashed a streaming record.

stories.head: GTA 6 reportedly passes 420m hours watched in its first 7 days on livestreams
stories.say: Three gaming stories you missed. Number one: GTA 6 reportedly hit over 420 million hours watched on streams in its first week, per Streams Charts. That's nearly three times the old record!

stories.head: Playground: Fable has over 150,000 lines of dialogue from 100+ UK voice actors
stories.say: Number two: Playground says Fable has over 150,000 lines of dialogue, recorded by over a hundred voice actors from all over the UK.

stories.head: EA's Skate drops seasons: Season 5 ends December 1, skate.Pass gone by year end
stories.say: And number three: EA's Skate is ditching seasons. Season five ends December 1st, and the skate pass is gone by the end of the year.

outro.head: Did you watch GTA 6 streams?
outro.say: Did you watch GTA 6 streams? Follow Level Up!
